title: Abbey of Ink and Vine
rules: Play over 4 seasons. Each player starts with 5 monks, 2 Ink, 1 Gold, 1 Wine, plus 1 random Commission card in hand and 2 Prestige.
Each season players take turns clockwise placing 1 monk at a time until all monks are placed; on your turn you must place to an empty circle and resolve it immediately, or send to the Chapter House.
Copy Desk: pay 1 Ink to gain 1 Manuscript. Illumination Loft: pay 1 Manuscript and 1 Gold to gain 4 Prestige and advance 1 step on Devotion.

Vineyard Terraces (2 circles per season, first-come blocked): gain 2 Wine, or 3 Wine during the fourth season. Press Cellar (1 circle): gain 1 Gold for every 2 Wine you currently store, keeping the Wine.
Sell Stall: sell any mix of Manuscripts and Wine for 2 Gold each, plus 1 bonus Gold if you sell 3 or more at once. Supply Stall: buy up to 2 Ink at 1 Gold each and gain 1 Prestige if you buy 2.

Chapel (1 circle): advance 2 Devotion and gain 1 Ink. Library (1 circle): draw 2 cards from the 32-card Commission deck, keep 1 in hand and return the other to the bottom, or discard a hand card to gain 2 Gold.
Chapter House holds up to 3 monks per player per season and never blocks; each monk placed there immediately advances you 1 Devotion.

Once per turn before or after placing you may fulfill 1 Commission either from your hand or from the 4 face-up row cards by paying its Manuscript, Wine and Gold cost; gain its printed Prestige, keep it in your tableau for its permanent engine power, and refill the row to 4.

End of each season the player with the most monks in the Chapter House becomes Abbot for next season: gain 3 Prestige, take first turn, and choose 2 Gold or 2 Ink; ties break by higher Devotion then more stored Wine; every other player with at least 1 monk there gains 1 Prestige.
Then collect monks back, place an age marker on each unsold Wine you store, refill the row to 4, and start the next season with the Abbot to act first.
Devotion thresholds pay once when reached: at 4 gain 2 Gold, at 8 gain a temporary sixth monk for one later season, at 12 gain 5 Prestige.
